name: Mootlanders

specialRules.name: Weak Halflings
specialRules.text: Halflings are weak and easily knocked senseless: when rolling for a Halfling's injury, a roll of 2 is treated as stunned (printed for D6; see conversionNotes).

equipmentLists.name: Mootlander equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Moot Elder, Halfling Thieves, Scouts, Warriors

items.name: Ladle
items.note: Strength -1 (user's minus 1); no armour save except shields/skills; Knuckle Cracking: if it hits and scores a natural 12 to wound (printed 6) the enemy drops his weapon

items.name: Cooking Pot Helmet
items.note: Master Chef with a Cooking Pot has a 9+ save (printed 5+) against being stunned, never modified

fighters.name: Moot Elder

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Moot Elder may use his Leadership when taking Ld tests.

fighters.notes: May be armed with a pistol for 15 gc (in list). Skill table row is 'Ring Leader'.

fighters.name: Halfling Master Chef

specialRules.name: Inspired Cooking
specialRules.text: Any Halfling models within 6" of the Master Chef may re-roll any failed hits in combat (once per turn).

fighters.notes: Equipped from the Master Chef utensils list only.

fighters.name: Halfling Thief

specialRules.name: Sneaky
specialRules.text: Can hide in the slightest shadow or cover. Always has a -1 to hit modifier when shot at, in addition to other modifiers.

fighters.notes: Entry heading says 0-2; Choice of Warriors text says up to three.

fighters.name: Halfling Warrior
fighters.notes: Bought in groups of 1-5; any number allowed.

specialRules.name: Keen Eyesight
specialRules.text: Can spot hidden enemies at twice their Initiative value in inches.

conversionNotes: PDF is a scan (low-resolution house-rules page images); profiles read from images.

Halfling injury rule 'a roll of 2 is stunned' left as printed; the schema has no D12 injury-table conversion for it (1 -> 1-2 pattern suggests 3-4). Confirm. Tenderiser 'stuns on 2-4' also left as printed.
Conversions: Master Chef Cooking Pot save vs stun 5+ -> 9+; Ladle Knuckle Cracking 'a 6' -> natural 12.
Master Chef list as printed shows only four utensils (the page may end there); Cooking Pot Helmet is duplicated into the Chef list because the rules say a Chef may be equipped with one. Confirm.
Halfling Thieves: heading 0-2 vs Choice of Warriors 'up to three'; max set to 2 (heading).
Moot Elder min 1; Master Chef 'may have one': min 0 max 1. Warband maximum printed as 20 models.
No spell list. Scout and Warrior profiles are identical as printed.
